bayer_isp.description: Raw Bayer in, linear RGB in the target colour space out. For any Bayer sensor: geometry and CFA phase arrive with the stream, tuning arrives at run time. Output encoding (a tone curve) and anything the design adds belong to the design, not here.

bit_depth.description: Depth samples arrive at here; the receiver scales the wire depth to it. Traced through every block from here.

max_width.description: Widest frame any sensor served may send: what the demosaic's line buffers are sized from.

max_height.description: Tallest frame any sensor served may send.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Raw Bayer, up to max_width x max_height at bit_depth. The context facts ride with the stream, latched at each frame's start, never registers.

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: Linear RGB, three channels in one word: R low, G mid, B high. Width traced, not declared.

blacklevel.description: Remove the sensor pedestal per CFA colour, before anything multiplies the signal.

whitebalance.description: Per-CFA-colour gain, the AWB loop's actuator. Before demosaic: interpolating unbalanced planes bakes the imbalance into all three channels.

ha_green.description: Hamilton-Adams green reconstruction, direction-adaptive; emits the (raw, green) word the chroma stage differences against.

ha_rb.description: Red and blue as colour differences against the reconstructed green.

ccm.description: Sensor RGB into the target colour space.
